implementation_note.decoder_contract: single frozen R3 decoder: two-layer flooding damped EMS with nm=32 (= q, so the EMS check update is the EXACT min-sum GF(32) check update, validated exhaustively against brute-force on small configurations), max_iter=100, workers=1 semantics by construction, whole-graph syndrome check after every full iteration, fail-closed on NaN/Inf/non-finite/wrong length/malformed syndrome/allocation breach, no fallback, no Alice truth in any public signature. Layer-0 (high words) is decoded first; layer-1 (low words) priors are formed ONLY from Bob/public/verified layer-0 output (conditional prior law, test-proven against brute-force conditional enumeration; uniform-degenerate case when layer-0 disagrees with Bob's high word); a failed layer-0 short-circuits before layer-1 decoding and before verification. Joint 64-bit Toeplitz tag over the concatenated corrected layers; ALL layer syndromes count as disclosure.
